prompt_md: 4 friends each draw a name from a hat for a gift swap. If anyone draws their own name, all names go back and everyone redraws. On average, how many draws does it take?
prompt_short: 4-person gift draw, redraw if anyone gets themselves. Average draws?
hint_md: Count the ways to hand out 4 names so nobody gets their own.
explain_intuition_md: Each person dodges their own name with chance 3 in 4, and multiplying four of those gives about 32%, or about 3.2 draws. But the draws aren't independent: if I take your name, you're a bit more likely to avoid your own. Of the 24 ways to hand out the names, 9 work.
explain_math_md: There are $D_4 = 9$ derangements of 4, so $P = \tfrac{9}{24} = \tfrac38$ and $$E = \tfrac83 \approx 2.67$$
